analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 -8.19%, -4.57% 급락으로 하락 추세 강화. RSI 38.6으로 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램 개선 중이나 아직 추세 전환 신호는 미약. ADX 25.3으로 뚜렷한 추세 유지. 현재가 $257.56은 스윙 지지선 $238.57 대비 높은 수준이나, 52주 고가 대비 19.0% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준. 매수 진입은 추세 전환 확인 후.
analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day drops of -8.19% and -4.57% strengthen the downtrend. RSI at 38.6 enters oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving but trend reversal signal remains weak. ADX at 25.3 maintains a clear trend. Current price $257.56 is above swing support at $238.57 but remains low at 19.0% of the 52-week high. Waiting for trend reversal confirmation before entering long.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 4 consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI entering oversold and MACD histogram improvement slightly increased the buy score, but the downtrend remains strong, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
